items.title: Connecting arpeg and enveLFO
items.text: Install the Python extra with uv sync --extra envelfo in this checkout, or pip install 'arpeg[envelfo]' for a published package. The optional module is arpeg.envelfo; ordinary arpeg imports do not import the enveLFO runtime. Rust hosts use the separate arpeg-envelfo crate. Neither event core depends on the other. This integration has no NumPy, audio engine, Python bindings, MIDI device dependency, or new executable. The Rust MIDI player is used only as a device-free development dependency in its conformance tests. The Python MidiPlayer examples additionally require arpeg[midi,envelfo] (or both extras with uv); the bridge itself remains independent of meedee and MIDI devices.

items.title: Contract and scheduling phases
items.text:
The host owns time, tempo/transport observations, MIDI delivery, and observation cadence. A bridge connects one arpeg hit output to a Patch-owned Envelope's start command, and maps named Patch outputs to breath, bend, or pressure. Other arpeg events do nothing. Multiple same-time hits retain their input order and receive distinct Envelope command ordinals. The bridge does not route note-end to release automatically: a rhythmic hit Envelope is not a voice gate.

An arp lane is distinct from an expression lane such as breath or bend. Player events carry a 1-based MIDI channel, but the bridge triggers on every supplied hit without filtering its channel. To trigger from one arp lane, filter events by event.channel before calling receive. Returned expression controls are broadcast to the configured owning arp lanes; they have no per-arp-lane target.

For each scheduled timestamp:

  1. Deliver input and transport changes using arpeg's existing ordering. Supply any tempo change through schedule's tempo argument, not the one-call set_tempo method, so an attack at that boundary stays unrealized.
  2. Call player.schedule for that timestamp, then drain its port events. This advances the note engine but does not construct or send the scheduled MIDI.
  3. Deliver its hit events to bridge.receive at their exact host seconds.
  4. Call bridge.observe once after all same-time hits, supplying the explicit next-delivery time for Threshold edges.
  5. Pass the returned expression controls to player.realize. Due releases and replacement note-offs precede the fresh entry controllers and note-ons. Continuing notes on other channels receive the new samples once per channel; released or muted notes receive no extra controllers. Deliver the returned MIDI in order.

All same-time hits are delivered before one observation, preserving the existing shared-channel expression policy. Each attack at that boundary uses that sample; no per-note observation or extra clock advancement is implicit. The ordinary advance method runs the same schedule/realize path without new samples.

Do not substitute an event's beat position for host seconds. Supply Python's tempo_map or Rust's per-child ClockMapping when the Patch has beat-clock children. Apply the same accepted tempo/transport observations to both mappings. The default seconds clock keeps advancing while arpeg is stopped; a beat clock follows its host's elapsed-beat mapping. A transport seek relocates arpeg but does not implicitly reset every enveLFO child. Send explicit Patch commands when a particular Envelope or LFO should reset, release, or seek.

The original after-note-on decision has been replaced by this explicit two-phase path. Newly triggered expression is now available to instruments that latch controllers at note-on. An Envelope still starts at its defined initial value, which may legitimately be zero; the bridge does not advance its attack to invent a nonzero onset.

Do not use player.control between these phases. Supply expression samples to realize instead. Other player mutations require realization first; stop is the exception, cancelling unsent attacks and releasing only actually realized notes. Draining port events is allowed between phases. Note lifecycle events are produced during realization, so drain again afterwards if the host consumes note_start/note_end events. A cancelled scheduled hit does not undo any enveLFO commands the host has already delivered.

A host may wake irregularly, but must still process every scheduled boundary chronologically. Advancing the player far ahead and then feeding old hits back at the wake-up time loses their timing and cannot be repaired by this bridge. Merge arpeg deadlines, enveLFO event/next-delivery deadlines, external input, and the chosen expression-observation schedule. LiveArpeggiator.next_deadline includes every arp lane, queued strum attack and owned release. Strum attacks after the parent hit still need their own scheduling/observation boundaries. realize rejects fresh samples if its pending batch spans multiple attack boundaries. A single fractional boundary remains valid when the host wakes at the next representable clock tick; note and decision beat timestamps remain exact. An invalid ownership/range control leaves the batch available for correction. This is an explicit host composition, not a second autonomous scheduler or a fixed-rate polling loop. Drain port batches after operations and honor exhausted; never silently drop an over-capacity batch. Feedback, density, gate, and selection mappings are not implemented here. There is no same-time feedback loop.

items.title: Python
items.text:
Prepare the independent LFO and hit-triggered Envelope as one standalone Patch:

from fractions import Fraction

from envelfo import patch
from ufor import envelfo
from ufor.segments import Segment

from arpeg.envelfo import EnveLFOBridge

definition = patch.PreparedPatch(
    envelfos={
        "wave": envelfo.LFO(rate=1, shape="triangle", center=0.5, depth=0.5),
        "attack": envelfo.Envelope(
            start="event",
            retrigger="reset",
            segments=[Segment(duration="250 ms", to=1)],
        ),
    },
    outputs={"breath": "wave", "accent": "attack"},
)
bridge = EnveLFOBridge(
    definition=definition,
    state=patch.initial_patch(definition, Fraction(0)),
    hit_target="attack",
    expression={"breath": "breath", "pressure": "accent"},
)

Configure the player's profile with expression = { lanes = { breath = "envelfo", pressure = "envelfo" } }. Bend retains its current or recorded ownership. Input controllers continue to be captured; an enveLFO-owned lane does not overwrite the captured source data. The player rejects controls for lanes not explicitly owned by enveLFO.

At a host-selected boundary, with player, at_ns, and next_delivery supplied by that host:

player.schedule(at_ns)  # Or schedule(at_ns, tempo=bpm) at a tempo boundary.
at = Fraction(at_ns, 1_000_000_000)  # relative to the Patch's chosen host epoch
batch = player.take_events()
if batch.exhausted:
    raise RuntimeError("arpeg output capacity exhausted")
events = []
for event in batch.events:
    events.extend(bridge.receive(at, event))
observation = bridge.observe(at, next_delivery=next_delivery)
events.extend(observation.events)
messages = player.realize(observation.controls)

The bridge returns all named floating-point values as well as rational ArpeggiatorControl samples. Python converts the signal's decimal representation to a Fraction; Rust approximates the floating signal with its existing rational type. Arpeg's existing normalized-range checks and MIDI quantization still apply. An out-of-range sample fails before committing the bridge observation. Host event times remain exact rationals, never floating-point approximations.

Save player.model_dump_json() and bridge.model_dump_json() together at the same phase boundary, including between scheduling and realization if needed. The player retains its pending engine output; do not schedule it a second time. Restore with their respective model_validate_json methods. The bridge includes Patch definitions, child state, pending deliveries, and retained values. Resupply the same host clock mapping after restoration. Any messages or returned events already collected but not yet delivered belong to the host and must also be saved or drained consistently.

items.title: Rust
items.text:
Build a normalized envelfo_core::patch::Patch with the same wave LFO, attack Envelope, and breath/accent outputs. Set Envelope start to Start::Event and retrigger to Retrigger::Initial. Then initialize:

```rust,ignore use arpeg_core::ports::InputPort; use arpeg_envelfo::EnveLFOBridge; use envelfo_core::{patch::Seconds, time::Time};

let state = definition.initial(Time::ZERO, "patch", 0, None, &Seconds)?; let mut bridge = EnveLFOBridge::new( definition, state, "attack".into(), vec![ (InputPort::Breath, "breath".into()), (InputPort::Pressure, "accent".into()), ], )?;

player.schedule(at_us, None)?; // Or Some(bpm) at a tempo boundary. let batch = player.take_events(); assert!(!batch.exhausted); let at = Time::new(at_us, 1_000_000)?; for event in &batch.events { let events = bridge.receive(at, event, &Seconds)?; // Deliver or retain returned enveLFO events in the host. } let observation = bridge.observe(at, next_delivery, &Seconds)?; let messages = player.realize(&observation.controls)?; ```

Rust bridge continuation uses Clone, including pending Patch deliveries. There is no serialized Rust bridge/player snapshot or cross-language snapshot interchange in this slice. The host must preserve its arpeg and delivery state alongside the bridge using its own existing continuation mechanism.

The complete normalized Rust construction is in the composition tests. Run cargo test -p arpeg-envelfo --locked without Python or MIDI devices. Run uv run --frozen pytest test/test_envelfo.py for Python. Both consume one shared trace, covering expressive controllers between notes, tempo changes, stop/start, seek, and final release. The independent pre-note wire cases cover all three expression lanes, overlapping replacements, boundary tempo changes, muted updates and captured phrases with recorded/current lane ownership.

items.title: What these checks cover
items.text:
tools/check_performance.py and the Rust check_performance example exercise the real MIDI players without opening MIDI ports. Each two-second workload holds one latched note at 120 BPM with sixteenth-note steps and a 150% gate, so successive occurrences hand off channel 1. Equal-valued CC2 messages arrive at 1,000 or 4,000 samples per second. The recovery case deliberately stalls the host loop for 200 ms halfway through the run.

Both probes poll with a 1 ms sleep and drain decision/lifecycle notifications. They check matching occurrence identities, release every owned note on Stop, and fail if an event buffer exhausts. Timing numbers are observations, not pass/fail thresholds or a real-time guarantee.

Run the probes one at a time after builds finish:

uv run --frozen python tools/check_performance.py --controller-hz 1000
uv run --frozen python tools/check_performance.py --controller-hz 4000
uv run --frozen python tools/check_performance.py --controller-hz 1000 --stall-ms 200
cargo run -p arpeg-midi --example check_performance --release --locked

The Rust command runs all three cases. Release CI runs both probes on each native platform and leaves their reports in the job logs.

batch_p99_us measures player processing and event collection, excluding the poll sleep. Note lateness compares exact lifecycle beats with the wall time at the end of their processing batch. It includes wake-up jitter and batch work. The current hosts generate complete batches before output-budget admission and delivery. These probes measure generation and collection, not port acceptance. Byte rate counts MIDI message bytes, including repeated controllers and entry bundles. It excludes transport framing. None of these numbers measures a MIDI driver, cable, synth, or audible latency.

items.title: Correctness and capacity evidence
items.text:
The Python/Rust dense-capture regression records 2,000 equal breath samples at 1 kHz. Fitting the phrase to a 100 ms gate retains the samples: its first 50 ms emits 1,000 controllers. Stop emits one matching release and cancels the remaining stream. This also demonstrates how fitting can greatly increase controller bandwidth; preserved data does not imply a receiver can keep up.

Existing shared lifecycle tests cover stale releases, handoffs, zero gates, repeats, pause/clear/seek cleanup, event-buffer exhaustion, and recovery after draining. Decision output is bounded at 4,096 events per lane, with up to 16 lanes merged by the player. The shared 4,096-event lifecycle buffer reserves every owned release; queued strum attacks also have a 4,096-entry limit. Phrase tests cover the 128-take limit and recovery through undo/clear. Captured input has a one-million-event admission limit.

Native archives retain executable permissions, playable profiles, and a matching SHA-256 checksum. The locally built macOS executable validates a profile without opening MIDI devices. Its dynamic dependencies are operating-system libraries; no Python, enge, NumPy, or external audio engine is linked. Hosted native jobs perform the same executable validation before retaining their archives. The publication job waits for all native and WebAssembly checks before attaching downloads to the release.

items.title: Remaining limitations and hardware checks
items.text:
The Python and Rust device hosts bound incoming queues at 4096 packets and 1 MiB of MIDI payload, with a 64 KiB packet/assembled SysEx limit. Limits are configurable, shared across note and clock inputs, and tested at capacity boundaries and with concurrent producers. Console input is also bounded. Overflow is fatal: release owned output, report the failure, and end the play session. Fake-port Python tests verify cleanup, including a release produced just before overflow. Rust tests cover fragmented SysEx and capacity reservation before payload allocation. There is no queue-age cutoff.

Native hosts now offer an optional output byte budget, disabled by default. --output-bytes-per-second sets the refill rate and --output-burst-bytes sets the allowance (default 64 bytes). Whole player-produced batches are admitted before any sends, retaining order and controller samples. Overload refuses the batch, reports an error, and ends playback. Cleanup bypasses the budget and uses a ledger of notes accepted by the port, rather than the player's potentially newer generated note. Python/Rust tests cover exact refill boundaries, burst caps, failed sends, release velocity, and refused note-entry groups; a Python fake-port test verifies cleanup when the player has already selected a new note.

Hosts timestamp callbacks, use 1 ms polling, and send due output immediately; they do not yet use driver timestamps or future output scheduling. There is no controller coalescer or pacing queue. A long stall can produce a late burst within capacity, or end a session when its configured output budget is exceeded. Sustained input overload also ends the session. The input limits cover arpeg's retained payload, not MIDI-library or driver buffers. The output budget estimates capacity, without measuring driver queue occupancy. Python receives raw MIDI 1 bytes through meedee and maintains independent bounded decoders for note/shared-clock and separate-clock inputs. Decoder diagnostics, receive drops and sequence gaps end playback. Automated checks do not establish a latency ceiling or prove device operation under a MIDI storm.

Hardware verification is pending. When the devices are available:

  1. Use a MIDI loopback destination and timestamp the returned notes/controllers to measure actual delivery order and timing, including dense breath.
  2. Play the wind-controller profile into the intended synth; check inherited breath, delayed attack, bend, and release articulation.
  3. Check Stop, external-clock loss/reacquisition, clear, and a disconnect while notes are sounding. Software can attempt cleanup but cannot deliver a release through an already disconnected output.
  4. Repeat native installation/validation on systems without a Python/audio development environment. Linux/Windows hardware remains separate evidence from their hosted build and software checks.

items.title: meedee host migration, 2026-10-18
items.text:
The Rust device host now uses the HTTPS main branch of meedee instead of midir. Cargo.lock resolves meedee to 38c0cbcd8e267c8acb5c481cdd5cb56411663cdc. Only the device-host feature enables it. The Python host, musical engines, file renderer, WebAssembly bindings and authored profiles are unchanged.

Host callbacks continue to timestamp arrival with Instant; backend timestamp capture is disabled. Raw MIDI 1 chunks go through arpeg's existing bounded framer. Separate note/clock inputs retain independent parser state and use each client's own discovery snapshot. A changed clock selection during discovery fails explicitly. meedee receive drops or callback panics terminate playback. The existing byte budget and sent-note ownership decide output and cleanup; failed sends are not retried. Explicit connection closes report errors, including when musical cleanup has already failed. Rust native operations remain in-process and can block on a native driver; Python isolation is not implicitly introduced.

The Git dependency builds bundled libremidi successfully on this Mac with Rust 1.99.0, CMake 4.4.4 and the installed C++ toolchain. Rust workspace tests pass: 135 ordinary tests, with one native check ignored. The no-default-features suite passes 122 tests. Workspace Clippy with -D warnings, formatting and a release executable build pass. Standalone download documentation includes the statically linked transport licenses without changing the packaging tool. The WebAssembly dependency tree excludes meedee; the local Rust installation has no wasm32 target, so actual WebAssembly compilation remains with the existing release-only CI gate. No CI trigger changes or workflow runs were made.

The native check requires explicit invocation:

cargo test -p arpeg-midi --test native_host --locked -- --ignored --nocapture

It launches a supervised native fixture with a 30-second deadline, terminating its process group on timeout. The fixture creates only its own virtual source, clock source and destination, discovers their CLI indices and launches the actual arpeg play executable. It verifies NoteOn delivery and matching NoteOff after quit with internal clock, shared external clock and separate external clock. A fourth case sets the native receive budget below a NoteOn packet's size and checks explicit transport-loss termination without producing output. Ordinary test runs do not create endpoints or contact the MIDI service.

An agent-context attempt during this migration failed before creating endpoints, with CoreMIDI keeper initialization error 268435459. The owner's ordinary Terminal run passed all four cases, with the supervised result completing in 2.61 seconds. See the retained Terminal result. This establishes virtual-only production host behavior on this Mac, not physical interface latency, unplug/replug recovery or Linux/Windows qualification. Build dependencies and those platform gates remain explicit; release CI is still release-only.

Independent bounded decoders frame note and separate-clock inputs. Decoder diagnostics, receive drops, sequence gaps and worker failures end playback. Cleanup releases only successfully sent owned notes and does not retry failed sends. Native message channels use 1–16; existing wire output and musical conformance fixtures are unchanged.

The ordinary Python suite passes 488 tests. Ruff, Python formatting, type checks and pyupgrade pass. Native checks are explicitly selected, not part of ordinary test collection:

uv run --frozen --extra midi pytest -q -s test/qualification/python_host.py

Each process mode has a 45-second supervisor and uses only test-created virtual endpoints. The actual Python CLI delivers NoteOn and quit cleanup NoteOff with internal, shared external and separate external clocks. A fourth case per mode sets the native receive budget below a NoteOn packet's size, then checks explicit loss termination without another packet. That quiet-loss case exposed stale isolated drop reporting; the meedee revision above fixes it using the existing forwarder's idle wake-up, without additional MIDI traffic.

Source code in arpeg/bank.py 
class CaptureBank(BaseModel):
    """Record takes, then publish bank changes at the caller's step boundary."""

    mode: Literal["history", "phrase"]
    octaves: Octaves = Octaves()
    history_size: int = Field(default=8, ge=1)
    selection: (
        Literal["ascending", "descending", "played"]
        | IndexPattern
        | Grammar
        | Transition
        | IntervalEnvelope
    ) = "ascending"
    direction: Literal["forward", "reverse"] = "forward"
    retrigger_on_edit: bool = True
    recording: MidiCapture | None = None
    live_snapshot: CapturedPhrase | None = None
    takes: list[_Take] = Field(default_factory=list)
    published: list[BankNote] = Field(default_factory=list)
    revision: int = 0
    last_selected: BankNote | None = None
    selected_revision: int = -1
    history_floor: int = 0
    pattern_position: int = 0
    choice_count: int = 0

    @field_validator("selection")
    @classmethod
    def prepare_grammar(
        cls, selection: str | IndexPattern | Grammar | Transition | IntervalEnvelope
    ) -> str | IndexPattern | Transition | IntervalEnvelope:
        return selection.expand() if isinstance(selection, Grammar) else selection

    def record(
        self, capture_id: str, timebase: Timebase, profile: MidiCaptureProfile
    ) -> None:
        self.check_control("record")
        if any(t.phrase.capture_id == capture_id for t in self.takes):
            raise ValueError("capture ID already exists")
        self.recording = MidiCapture(
            capture_id=capture_id, timebase=timebase, profile=profile
        )
        self.live_snapshot = None
        self.history_floor = 0

    def accept(self, event: MidiEvent, note_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        if self.recording is None:
            raise ValueError("record before accepting MIDI")
        self.recording.accept(event, note_id)

    def advance(self, through_tick: int) -> None:
        """Make completed history notes eligible after their capture tail."""
        if self.mode == "history" and self.recording is not None:
            self.live_snapshot = self.recording.snapshot(through_tick)

    def commit(
        self, end_tick: int, update: Literal["replace", "overdub"] | None = None
    ) -> None:
        self.check_control("commit")
        assert self.recording is not None
        phrase = self.recording.finish(end_tick)
        if update is None:
            update = "overdub" if self.mode == "history" else "replace"
        self.takes.append(_Take(phrase=phrase, update=update))
        self.recording = None
        self.live_snapshot = None

    def undo_last_capture(self) -> None:
        self.check_control("undo")
        self.takes.pop()

    def check_control(self, command: str) -> None:
        """Validate a capture edit before emitting due playback events."""
        if command == "record":
            if self.recording is not None:
                raise ValueError("a capture is already recording")
        elif command in ("commit", "overdub"):
            if self.recording is None:
                raise ValueError("record before committing")
            if self.mode == "phrase" and len(self.takes) >= 128:
                raise ValueError(
                    "phrase reached its 128-take limit; undo or clear first"
                )
        elif command == "undo":
            if not self.takes:
                raise ValueError("there is no committed capture to undo")
        else:
            raise ValueError("capture command must be record, commit, overdub or undo")

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self.recording = None
        self.live_snapshot = None
        self.takes.clear()
        if self.published:
            self.revision += 1
        self.published.clear()
        self.last_selected = None
        self.pattern_position = 0

    def clear_history(self) -> None:
        """Forget selected history while preserving the live controller capture."""
        if self.mode != "history" or self.recording is None:
            raise ValueError("clear_history requires an active history capture")
        self.takes.clear()
        self.history_floor = len(self.recording.segments)
        self.published.clear()
        self.last_selected = None
        self.pattern_position = 0
        self.revision += 1

    def publish_step(self) -> list[BankNote]:
        """Apply pending edits once at the next rhythm opportunity."""
        notes: list[BankNote] = []
        for take in self.takes:
            if take.update == "replace":
                notes.clear()
            notes.extend(
                BankNote(capture_id=take.phrase.capture_id, note_id=n.note_id)
                for n in take.phrase.notes
            )
        if self.mode == "history":
            if self.live_snapshot is not None:
                notes.extend(
                    BankNote(
                        capture_id=self.live_snapshot.capture_id, note_id=n.note_id
                    )
                    for n in self.live_snapshot.notes[self.history_floor :]
                )
            notes = notes[-self.history_size :]
        if notes != self.published:
            self.published = notes
            self.revision += 1
        return self.published.copy()

    def select_step(
        self, step: int = 0, seed: int | None = None, name: str = ""
    ) -> BankNote | None:
        """Publish changes and choose one identified note for this step."""
        bank = self.publish_step()
        if not bank:
            self.last_selected = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            return None
        if self.selected_revision != self.revision:
            if self.retrigger_on_edit:
                self.last_selected = None
                self.pattern_position = 0
            self.selected_revision = self.revision
        selection = self.selection
        ordered = self.ordered_notes(
            selection if isinstance(selection, str) else "ascending"
        )
        previous = (
            ordered.index(self.last_selected) if self.last_selected in ordered else None
        )
        if isinstance(selection, IndexPattern):
            index = selection.indices[self.pattern_position]
            self.pattern_position = (self.pattern_position + 1) % len(selection.indices)
            if selection.boundary == "rest" and index >= len(ordered):
                return None
        elif isinstance(selection, (Transition, IntervalEnvelope)):
            if seed is None:
                raise ValueError("random selection requires an explicit seed")
            if isinstance(selection, Transition):
                index, self.choice_count = transition_rank(
                    selection,
                    len(ordered),

def check_control(self, command: str) -> None:
    """Validate a capture edit before emitting due playback events."""

def publish_step(self) -> list[BankNote]:
    """Apply pending edits once at the next rhythm opportunity."""
    notes: list[BankNote] = []
    for take in self.takes:
        if take.update == "replace":
            notes.clear()
        notes.extend(
            BankNote(capture_id=take.phrase.capture_id, note_id=n.note_id)
            for n in take.phrase.notes
        )
    if self.mode == "history":
        if self.live_snapshot is not None:
            notes.extend(
                BankNote(
                    capture_id=self.live_snapshot.capture_id, note_id=n.note_id
                )
                for n in self.live_snapshot.notes[self.history_floor :]
            )
        notes = notes[-self.history_size :]

        self.published = notes

class MidiCapture(BaseModel):
    """Record one explicitly delimited phrase in native source ticks."""

    capture_id: str
    timebase: Timebase
    profile: MidiCaptureProfile = Field(default_factory=MidiCaptureProfile, frozen=True)
    events: list[MidiEvent] = Field(default_factory=list)
    segments: list[_Segment] = Field(default_factory=list)
    prefix_events: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list)
    controller_state: dict[str, EntryState] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    active: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reported_notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    advanced_through: int | None = None
    closed: bool = False

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def initial_state(self) -> Self:
        if not self.controller_state:
            self.controller_state = {"breath": EntryState()}
            if self.profile.track_bend:
                self.controller_state["bend"] = EntryState()
        return self

    def accept(self, event: MidiEvent, note_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Append one wire event in (tick, ordinal) order."""
        if self.closed:
            raise ValueError("capture has ended")
        if self.advanced_through is not None and event.tick <= self.advanced_through:
            raise ValueError("MIDI event arrived after its capture time was published")
        if (
            event.tick < 0
            or self.events
            and (
                event.tick,
                event.ordinal,
            )
            <= (self.events[-1].tick, self.events[-1].ordinal)
        ):
            raise ValueError("capture events must increase in (tick, ordinal) order")
        status = event.data[0]
        kind = status & 0xF0
        onset = (
            0x80 <= status < 0xF0
            and status & 15 == self.profile.channel
            and kind == 0x90
            and len(event.data) == 3
            and event.data[2] > 0
        )
        if onset:
            if note_id is None:
                note_id = f"note-{len(self.segments)}"
            if any(n.note_id == note_id for n in self.segments):
                raise ValueError("duplicate source note ID")
            if (
                self.profile.overlap == "handoff"
                and self.segments
                and self.segments[-1].onset_tick == event.tick
            ):
                raise ValueError("simultaneous onsets require independent overlap")
        index = len(self.events)
        self.events.append(event)
        if not 0x80 <= status < 0xF0 or status & 15 != self.profile.channel:
            self._retain_context(index)
            return
        if kind == 0xD0 and len(event.data) == 2:
            self.controller_state["pressure"] = EntryState(
                value=event.data[1] / 127, source_event=index
            )
            self._expression_or_context(index)
            return
        if len(event.data) != 3:
            self._retain_context(index)
            return
        _, first, value = event.data
        if onset:
            assert note_id is not None
            self._onset(index, first, value, note_id)
        elif kind == 0x80 or kind == 0x90 and value == 0:
            self._release(index, first, value)
        elif kind == 0xB0 and first == self.profile.breath_cc:
            self.controller_state["breath"] = EntryState(
                value=value / 127, source_event=index
            )
            self._expression_or_context(index)
        elif kind == 0xE0 and self.profile.track_bend:
            bend = (first | value << 7) - 8192
            self.controller_state["bend"] = EntryState(
                value=bend / 8192, source_event=index
            )
            self._expression_or_context(index)
        else:
            self._retain_context(index)

    def finish(self, end_tick: int) -> CapturedPhrase:
        """End open gates and trailing cells at the declared phrase boundary."""
        if self.closed:
            raise ValueError("capture has ended")
        if (
            end_tick < 0
            or self.events
            and end_tick < self.events[-1].tick
            or self.advanced_through is not None
            and end_tick < self.advanced_through
        ):
            raise ValueError("phrase end precedes source events")
        for segment in self.segments:
            if segment.gate_end_tick is None:
                segment.gate_end_tick = end_tick
            if segment.cell_end_tick is None:
                segment.cell_end_tick = end_tick
        phrase = CapturedPhrase(
            capture_id=self.capture_id,
            timebase=self.timebase,
            end_tick=end_tick,
            events=self.events,
            prefix_events=self.prefix_events,
            notes=[self._source_note(n) for n in self.segments],
        )
        self.closed = True
        return phrase

    def advance(self, through_tick: int) -> list[SourceNote]:
        """Publish newly complete cells after their declared capture tail."""
        if self.closed:
            raise ValueError("capture has ended")
        if (
            through_tick < 0
            or self.events
            and through_tick < self.events[-1].tick
            or self.advanced_through is not None
            and through_tick < self.advanced_through
        ):
            raise ValueError("capture time precedes source events")
        self.advanced_through = through_tick
        ready: list[SourceNote] = []
        for index, segment in enumerate(self.segments):
            gate = segment.gate_end_tick
            if gate is None or through_tick < gate + self.profile.tail_ticks:
                continue
            if segment.cell_end_tick is None and index not in self.active:
                segment.cell_end_tick = max(
                    gate + self.profile.tail_ticks, segment.onset_tick + 1
                )
                segment.following_events = [
                    i
                    for i in segment.following_events
                    if self.events[i].tick < segment.cell_end_tick
                ]
            if (
                segment.cell_end_tick is not None
                and segment.note_id not in self.reported_notes
            ):
                ready.append(self._source_note(segment))
                self.reported_notes.append(segment.note_id)
        return ready

    def snapshot(self, through_tick: int) -> CapturedPhrase:
        """Expose complete notes and the current source ledger while recording."""
        self.advance(through_tick)
        return CapturedPhrase(
            capture_id=self.capture_id,
            timebase=self.timebase,
            end_tick=through_tick,
            events=self.events,
            notes=[
                self._source_note(n)
                for n in self.segments
                if n.note_id in self.reported_notes
            ],
            prefix_events=self.prefix_events,
        )

    def _onset(self, index: int, key: int, velocity: int, note_id: str) -> None:
        tick = self.events[index].tick
        if self.profile.overlap == "handoff":
            for active in self.active:
                segment = self.segments[active]
                segment.gate_end_tick = tick
            self.active.clear()
            if self.segments and self.segments[-1].cell_end_tick is None:
                self.segments[-1].cell_end_tick = tick
        self.segments.append(
            _Segment(
                note_id=note_id,
                onset_tick=tick,
                onset_event=index,
                key=key,
                velocity=velocity,
                entry_state=self.controller_state.copy(),
            )
        )
        self.active.append(len(self.segments) - 1)

    def _release(self, index: int, key: int, velocity: int) -> None:
        for active in self.active:
            segment = self.segments[active]
            if segment.key == key:
                segment.gate_end_tick = self.events[index].tick
                segment.release_event = index
                segment.release_velocity = velocity
                self.active.remove(active)
                return
        self._retain_context(index)

    def _expression_or_context(self, index: int) -> None:
        if self.active:
            for active in self.active:
                self.segments[active].expression_events.append(index)
        elif self.segments:
            self._retain_context(index)

    def _retain_context(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not self.segments:
            self.prefix_events.append(index)
        elif not self.active and self.segments[-1].cell_end_tick is None:
            self.segments[-1].following_events.append(index)

    def _source_note(self, segment: _Segment) -> SourceNote:
        assert segment.gate_end_tick is not None
        assert segment.cell_end_tick is not None
        return SourceNote(
            capture_id=self.capture_id,
            note_id=segment.note_id,
            onset_tick=segment.onset_tick,
            gate_end_tick=segment.gate_end_tick,
            cell_end_tick=segment.cell_end_tick,
            onset_event=segment.onset_event,
            release_event=segment.release_event,
            expression_events=segment.expression_events,
            following_events=segment.following_events,
            entry_state=segment.entry_state,
            key=segment.key,
            velocity=segment.velocity / 127,
            release_velocity=(
                segment.release_velocity / 127
                if segment.release_velocity is not None
                else None
            ),
        )

def transition_rank(
    selection: Transition,
    size: int,
    previous: int | None,
    seed: int,
    name: str,
    revision: int,
    decision: int,
) -> tuple[int | None, int]:
    """Choose an expanded rank, consuming a draw only for an admitted transition."""
    if previous is None and selection.start == "lowest":
        return 0, decision
    row = (
        selection.weights[previous]
        if previous is not None and previous < len(selection.weights)
        else []
    )
    weights = [
        1 if previous is None else row[i] if i < len(row) else selection.missing_weight
        for i in range(size)
    ]
    if not any(weights):
        if selection.blocked == "rest":
            return None, decision
        weights = [1] * size
    chosen = draw_below(seed, name, "transition", revision, decision, sum(weights))
    index = 0
    while chosen >= weights[index]:
        chosen -= weights[index]
        index += 1
    return index, decision + 1

def interval_rank(
    selection: IntervalEnvelope,
    size: int,
    previous: int | None,
    seed: int,
    name: str,
    revision: int,
    step: int,
) -> int | None:
    """Choose a signed movement using the absolute rhythm step's range."""
    if previous is None:
        return 0
    interval = selection.ranges[step % len(selection.ranges)]
    low, high = interval.min, interval.max
    if selection.boundary == "rest":
        low, high = max(low, -previous), min(high, size - 1 - previous)
        if low > high:
            return None
    move = low + draw_below(
        seed, name, "interval_envelope", revision, step, high - low + 1
    )
    return (previous + move) % size

def draw_below(
    seed: int, name: str, lane: str, revision: int, decision: int, bound: int
) -> int:
    """Draw uniformly below a positive bound using the documented v1 mixer."""
    bits = (bound - 1).bit_length()
    retry = 0
    while True:
        value = 0
        for chunk in range((bits + 63) // 64):
            text = (
                f"arpeg-v1:{seed}:{len(name.encode())}:{name}:{lane}:"
                f"{revision}:{decision}:{retry}:{chunk}"
            )
            word = 0xCBF29CE484222325
            for byte in text.encode():
                word = ((word ^ byte) * 0x100000001B3) & _MASK
            word = ((word ^ (word >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9) & _MASK
            word = ((word ^ (word >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB) & _MASK
            value |= (word ^ (word >> 31)) << (chunk * 64)
        value &= (1 << bits) - 1
        if value < bound:
            return value
        retry += 1

class TransportClock(BaseModel):
    mode: ClockMode = ClockMode.internal
    bpm: int = Field(default=120, ge=1, le=1000)
    timeout_us: int = Field(default=500_000, gt=0)
    beat: Fraction = Fraction(0)
    anchor_beat: Fraction = Fraction(0)
    anchor_us: int | None = None
    running: bool = True
    last_pulse_us: int | None = None
    interval_us: int | None = None
    waiting: bool = True
    observations: list[ClockObservation] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def wait_for_external_transport(self) -> Self:
        if self.mode == ClockMode.external and self.anchor_us is None:
            self.running = False
        return self

    @property
    def active(self) -> bool:
        return (
            self.running
            and self.anchor_us is not None
            and (self.mode == ClockMode.internal or not self.waiting)
        )

    def advance(self, at_us: int) -> Fraction:
        if self.active:
            assert self.anchor_us is not None
            elapsed = max(0, at_us - self.anchor_us)
            if self.mode == ClockMode.internal:
                self.beat = self.anchor_beat + Fraction(elapsed * self.bpm, 60_000_000)
            else:
                if self.interval_us is not None:
                    self.beat = max(
                        self.beat,
                        self.anchor_beat
                        + min(Fraction(elapsed, self.interval_us), Fraction(1)) / 24,
                    )
                assert self.last_pulse_us is not None
                if at_us - self.last_pulse_us >= self.timeout_us:
                    self.running = False
                    self.waiting = True
        return self.beat

    def accept(self, at_us: int, data: list[int]) -> bool:
        """Return whether Start or song position requests a playback relocation."""
        self.advance(at_us)
        if len(self.observations) >= 1_000_000:
            raise ValueError("clock observation limit reached")
        self.observations.append(ClockObservation(at_us=at_us, data=data))
        status = data[0]
        if status == 0xFA or status == 0xF2:
            self.beat = (
                Fraction(0) if status == 0xFA else Fraction(data[1] + 128 * data[2], 4)
            )
            self.anchor_beat = self.beat
            self.anchor_us = at_us
            self.last_pulse_us = None
            self.interval_us = None
            self.waiting = True
            if status == 0xFA:
                self.running = True
            return True
        if status == 0xFC:
            self.running = False
            self.waiting = True
        elif status == 0xFB:
            self.running = True
            self.anchor_us = at_us
            self.anchor_beat = self.beat
            self.last_pulse_us = None
            self.interval_us = None
            self.waiting = True
        elif status == 0xF8 and self.mode == ClockMode.external and self.running:
            if self.last_pulse_us is not None and at_us <= self.last_pulse_us:
                return False
            if self.waiting:
                self.anchor_beat = self.beat
                self.waiting = False
            else:
                assert self.last_pulse_us is not None
                self.interval_us = at_us - self.last_pulse_us
                self.anchor_beat += Fraction(1, 24)
                self.beat = max(self.beat, self.anchor_beat)
            self.last_pulse_us = at_us
            self.anchor_us = at_us
        return False

    def set_tempo(self, at_us: int, bpm: int) -> None:
        if not 1 <= bpm <= 1000 or self.mode != ClockMode.internal:
            raise ValueError("tempo requires internal clock and BPM between 1 and 1000")
        self.advance(at_us)
        self.anchor_us = at_us
        self.anchor_beat = self.beat
        self.bpm = bpm

    def halt(self, at_us: int) -> None:
        """Stop even when observation storage has reached its limit."""
        self.advance(at_us)
        self.running = False
        self.waiting = True

class Arpeggiator(BaseModel, Generic[Payload, Event]):
    """Shared held/latched bank, selection, rhythm, and occurrence lifecycle.

    Input identities and ordering ranks are independent of opaque payloads.
    Adapters expand items, realize selected values, and construct output events.
    """

    settings: EngineSettings = EngineSettings()
    ports: TimingPorts | None = None
    next_step: Fraction = Fraction(0)
    step_index: int = 0
    bank_revision: int = 0
    decision_count: int = 0
    walk_count: int = 0
    walk_rank: int = 0
    pattern_position: int = 0
    shuffle_order: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list)
    shuffle_position: int = 0
    shuffle_revision: int = -1
    shuffle_count: int = 0
    choice_count: int = 0
    rising: bool = True
    pending: list[SerializeAsAny[_Attack[Payload]]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    now: Fraction = Fraction(0)
    next_input_id: int = 0
    next_output_id: int = 0
    previous_note: SerializeAsAny[Item[Payload]] | None = None
    input: list[SerializeAsAny[Item[Payload]]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    bank: list[SerializeAsAny[Item[Payload]]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    toggle_at: Fraction | None = None
    toggled_identities: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list)
    toggle_added_identities: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list)
    sounding: list[SerializeAsAny[_Active[Payload]]] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def prepare_ports(self) -> Self:
        if self.ports is None:
            self.ports = TimingPorts(
                gate=self.settings.gate, density=self.settings.probability
            )
        return self

    @cached_property
    def bank_mode(self) -> HeldBank | LatchedBank:
        bank = self.settings.bank
        assert isinstance(bank, (HeldBank, LatchedBank))
        return bank

    @cached_property
    def selection(
        self,
    ) -> (
        Ascending
        | Descending
        | Played
        | Alternating
        | InsideOut
        | OutsideIn
        | IndexPattern
        | Shuffle
        | Choice
        | Transition
        | IntervalEnvelope
        | Walk
    ):
        selection = self.settings.selection
        assert isinstance(
            selection,
            (
                Ascending,
                Descending,
                Played,
                Alternating,
                InsideOut,
                OutsideIn,
                IndexPattern,
                Shuffle,
                Choice,
                Transition,
                IntervalEnvelope,
                Walk,
            ),
        )
        return selection

    def press(
        self, at: Fraction, identity: int, rank: int, value: Payload
    ) -> list[Event]:
        """Add an item, leaving the step at ``at`` for ``advance``."""
        self._check_time(at)
        note = Item[Payload](
            id=self.next_input_id,
            source_id=self.next_input_id,
            identity=identity,
            rank=rank,
            value=value,
            onset=at,
        )
        events = self._process_until(at, inclusive=False)
        new_chord = not self.input
        self.input.append(note)
        edited = isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank)
        if isinstance(self.bank_mode, LatchedBank):
            if self.bank_mode.update == "replace":
                if new_chord:
                    self.bank.clear()
                self.bank.append(note)
                edited = True
            elif self.bank_mode.update == "add":
                self.bank.append(note)
                edited = True
            elif self.bank_mode.update == "toggle":
                if self.toggle_at != at:
                    self.toggle_at = at
                    self.toggled_identities.clear()
                    self.toggle_added_identities.clear()
                if identity not in self.toggled_identities:
                    edited = True
                    self.toggled_identities.append(identity)
                    if any(n.identity == identity for n in self.bank):
                        self.bank = [n for n in self.bank if n.identity != identity]
                    else:
                        self.bank.append(note)
                        self.toggle_added_identities.append(identity)
                elif identity in self.toggle_added_identities:
                    self.bank.append(note)
                    edited = True
            if not self.bank:
                self.previous_note = None
                self.pattern_position = 0
                self.shuffle_order.clear()
                self.shuffle_position = 0
                events.extend(self._release_all(at))
        if edited:
            self.bank_revision += 1
        if edited and self.settings.retrigger == "bank_edit":
            self.previous_note = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            self.shuffle_order.clear()
            self.shuffle_position = 0
        self.next_input_id += 1
        return events

    def release(self, at: Fraction, identity: int) -> list[Event]:
        """Release the oldest held item with this input identity."""
        self._check_time(at)
        if not any(n.identity == identity for n in self.input):
            raise ValueError("release has no matching onset")
        events = self._process_until(at, inclusive=False)
        self.input.pop(
            next(i for i, n in enumerate(self.input) if n.identity == identity)
        )
        if isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank):
            self.bank_revision += 1
        if (
            isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank)
            and self.settings.retrigger == "bank_edit"
        ):
            self.previous_note = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            self.shuffle_order.clear()
            self.shuffle_position = 0
        if not self.input and isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank):
            self.previous_note = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            self.shuffle_order.clear()
            self.shuffle_position = 0
            events.extend(self._release_all(at))
        return events

    def advance(self, through: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Emit all scheduled events through this beat, inclusive."""
        self._check_time(through)
        return self._process_until(through, inclusive=True)

    def before(self, through: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Release due notes before expression, leaving this beat's attacks pending."""
        self._check_time(through)
        events = self._process_until(through, inclusive=False)
        events.extend(self._release_due(through))
        return events

    def control(
        self, at: Fraction, control: arpeggiator_ports.ArpeggiatorControl
    ) -> list[Event]:
        self._check_time(at)
        assert self.ports is not None
        self.ports.check_control(control, self.settings.seed)
        events = Arpeggiator.before(self, at)
        self.ports.pending[control.port] = control.value
        return events

    def stop(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Release only this arpeggiator's sounding notes and clear its bank."""
        self._check_time(at)
        events = self._process_until(at, inclusive=False)
        events.extend(self._release_all(at))
        active = self.input if isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank) else self.bank
        if active:
            self.bank_revision += 1
        self.input.clear()
        self.bank.clear()
        self.toggle_at = None
        self.toggled_identities.clear()
        self.toggle_added_identities.clear()
        self.previous_note = None
        self.pattern_position = 0
        self.shuffle_order.clear()
        self.shuffle_position = 0
        self.now = at
        return events

    def clear(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Clear a latched bank and release its owned output notes."""
        self._check_time(at)
        if isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank):
            raise ValueError("clear requires a latched bank")
        events = self._process_until(at, inclusive=False)
        if self.bank:
            self.bank_revision += 1
        self.bank.clear()
        self.toggle_at = None
        self.toggled_identities.clear()
        self.toggle_added_identities.clear()
        self.previous_note = None
        self.pattern_position = 0
        self.shuffle_order.clear()
        self.shuffle_position = 0
        events.extend(self._release_all(at))
        return events

    def next_deadline(self) -> Fraction:
        """Return the next step, pending attack, or owned release beat."""
        return min(
            [
                self.next_step,
                *(n.end for n in self.sounding),
                *(n.at for n in self.pending),
            ]
        )

    def pause(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Cancel output while retaining input notes and selector position."""
        events = self._release_all(at)
        self.now = at
        rhythm = self.settings.rhythm
        assert isinstance(rhythm, (Grid, Euclidean, Pattern))
        while self.next_step < at:
            self.next_step += decide_step(
                rhythm, self.step_index, self.settings.gate, self.settings.patterns
            ).duration
            self.step_index += 1
        return events

    def relocate(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        """Seek the rhythm and restart traversal without forgetting held notes."""
        events = self._release_all(at)
        assert self.ports is not None
        self.ports.pending.clear()
        rhythm = self.settings.rhythm
        if isinstance(rhythm, Pattern):
            cycle = sum(
                (Fraction(s.duration.removesuffix(" beat")) for s in rhythm.steps),
                Fraction(0),
            )
            cycles = at // cycle
            self.next_step = cycles * cycle
            self.step_index = cycles * len(rhythm.steps)
            while self.next_step < at:
                self.next_step += decide_step(
                    rhythm, self.step_index, self.settings.gate, self.settings.patterns
                ).duration
                self.step_index += 1
        else:
            assert isinstance(rhythm, (Grid, Euclidean))
            step = Fraction(rhythm.step.removesuffix(" beat"))
            self.step_index, self.next_step = grid_position(
                step, rhythm.swing, at, rhythm.groove
            )
        self.now = at
        self.previous_note = None
        self.rising = True
        self.pattern_position = 0
        self.shuffle_order.clear()
        self.shuffle_position = 0
        return events

    def _check_time(self, at: Fraction) -> None:
        if at < self.now:
            raise ValueError("live time must not go backwards")

    def _process_until(self, through: Fraction, *, inclusive: bool) -> list[Event]:
        events: list[Event] = []
        while (at := Arpeggiator.next_deadline(self)) < through or (
            inclusive and at == through
        ):
            events.extend(self._release_due(at))
            if self.next_step == at:
                rhythm = self.settings.rhythm
                assert isinstance(rhythm, (Grid, Euclidean, Pattern))
                assert self.ports is not None
                admitted = self.ports.begin_step(
                    at,
                    self.step_index,
                    self.bank_revision,
                    cycle=starts_cycle(rhythm, self.step_index),
                )
                decision = decide_step(
                    rhythm, self.step_index, self.ports.gate, self.settings.patterns
                )
                if admitted:
                    hit = self._schedule_step(at, decision)
                    if not (
                        isinstance(rhythm, Pattern)
                        and isinstance(
                            rhythm.steps[self.step_index % len(rhythm.steps)], TieStep
                        )
                    ):
                        self.ports.outcome(hit)
                self.next_step += decision.duration
                self.step_index += 1
            while self.pending and self.pending[0].at == at:
                events.extend(self._attack(self.pending.pop(0)))
        self.now = through
        return events

    def _release_due(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        events = [
            self._event(
                at=n.end,
                kind="off",
                id=n.id,
                source_id=n.source_id,
                value=n.value,
                accent=n.accent,
            )
            for n in self.sounding
            if n.end <= at
        ]
        self.sounding = [n for n in self.sounding if n.end > at]
        return events

    def _schedule_step(self, at: Fraction, decision: RhythmDecision) -> bool:
        active = self.input if isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank) else self.bank
        assert self.ports is not None
        active = self._expand(active)
        if not active:
            self.previous_note = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            self.shuffle_order.clear()
            self.shuffle_position = 0
            return False
        if not decision.repeats or not decision.accent:
            return False
        body = self.settings
        assert self.ports is not None
        probability = self.ports.density
        decision_index = self.decision_count
        self.decision_count += 1
        if probability == 0:
            return False
        if probability < 1:
            assert body.seed is not None
            if (
                draw_below(
                    body.seed,
                    self.settings.name,
                    "probability",
                    self.bank_revision,
                    decision_index,
                    probability.denominator,
                )
                >= probability.numerator
            ):
                return False
        ordered = sorted(active, key=self._selection_key)
        if body.strum is not None:
            spacing = Fraction(body.strum.spacing.removesuffix(" beat"))
            if len(self.pending) + len(ordered) * decision.repeats > 4096:
                raise ValueError("strum exceeds the 4096 pending-attack limit")
            interval = decision.duration / decision.repeats
            attacks = []
            ranked = sorted(
                active, key=lambda n: self._entry_key(n, Fraction(n.rank), False)
            )
            for i, note in enumerate(ordered):
                if self.ports.selection_offset.ranks:
                    if (
                        rank := self.ports.offset_rank(ranked.index(note), len(ranked))
                    ) is None:
                        continue
                    note = ranked[rank]
                if (value := self._realize(note, decision.accent, 0)) is None:
                    continue
                attacks.extend(
                    _Attack[Payload](
                        at=at + j * interval + i * spacing,
                        note=note,
                        value=value,
                        accent=decision.accent,
                        gate=decision.final_gate
                        if j == decision.repeats - 1
                        else decision.gate,
                    )
                    for j in range(decision.repeats)
                )
            self.pending.extend(attacks)
            self.pending.sort(key=lambda a: a.at)
            return bool(attacks)
        pitch_interval = 0
        if isinstance(selection := self.selection, IndexPattern):
            index = selection.indices[self.pattern_position]
            if selection.intervals is not None:
                pitch_interval = selection.intervals[self.pattern_position]
            self.pattern_position = (self.pattern_position + 1) % len(selection.indices)
            if selection.boundary == "rest" and index >= len(ordered):
                return False
            note = ordered[index % len(ordered)]
        elif isinstance(selection, Choice):
            candidates = [
                (
                    n,
                    selection.weights[i % len(selection.weights)]
                    if selection.extend == "repeat" or i < len(selection.weights)
                    else 1,
                )
                for i, n in enumerate(ordered)
                if not selection.no_repeat
                or len(ordered) == 1
                or self.previous_note is None
                or n.id != self.previous_note.id
            ]
            note = self._weighted_note(candidates, "choice")
        elif isinstance(selection, (Transition, IntervalEnvelope)):
            previous = next(
                (
                    i
                    for i, n in enumerate(ordered)
                    if self.previous_note is not None and n.id == self.previous_note.id
                ),
                None,
            )
            seed = self.settings.seed
            assert seed is not None
            if isinstance(selection, Transition):
                rank, self.choice_count = transition_rank(
                    selection,
                    len(ordered),
                    previous,
                    seed,
                    self.settings.name,
                    self.bank_revision,
                    self.choice_count,
                )
            else:
                rank = interval_rank(
                    selection,
                    len(ordered),
                    previous,
                    seed,
                    self.settings.name,
                    self.bank_revision,
                    self.step_index,
                )
            if rank is None:
                return False
            note = ordered[rank]
        elif isinstance(selection, Shuffle):
            note = self._shuffle_note(ordered, selection)
        elif isinstance(selection, (InsideOut, OutsideIn)):
            size = len(ordered)
            indices = sorted(
                range(size),
                key=lambda i: (
                    abs(2 * i - (size - 1))
                    if isinstance(selection, InsideOut)
                    else min(i, size - 1 - i)
                ),
            )
            ordered = [ordered[i] for i in indices]
            previous = next(
                (
                    i
                    for i, n in enumerate(ordered)
                    if self.previous_note is not None and n.id == self.previous_note.id
                ),
                None,
            )
            note = ordered[0 if previous is None else (previous + 1) % size]
        elif isinstance(selection, Alternating):
            if self.previous_note is None:
                self.rising = True
                note = ordered[0]
            elif len(ordered) == 1:
                note = ordered[0]
            else:
                previous_key = self._selection_key(self.previous_note)
                candidates = ordered if self.rising else list(reversed(ordered))
                note = next(
                    (
                        n
                        for n in candidates
                        if (
                            self._selection_key(n) > previous_key
                            if self.rising
                            else self._selection_key(n) < previous_key
                        )
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                if note is None:
                    self.rising = not self.rising
                    candidates.reverse()
                    note = next(
                        (
                            n
                            for n in candidates
                            if (
                                self._selection_key(n) >= previous_key
                                if self.rising
                                else self._selection_key(n) <= previous_key
                            )
                            and (
                                selection.repeat_endpoints
                                or n.id != self.previous_note.id
                            )
                        ),
                        candidates[0],
                    )
        elif isinstance(selection, Walk):
            previous = next(
                (
                    i
                    for i, n in enumerate(ordered)
                    if self.previous_note is not None and n.id == self.previous_note.id
                ),
                None,
            )
            move = previous is not None or (
                selection.start == "move"
                if self.previous_note is None
                else selection.on_remove == "rank"
            )
            rank = (
                previous
                if previous is not None
                else (
                    self.walk_rank % len(ordered)
                    if self.previous_note is not None and selection.on_remove == "rank"
                    else 0
                )
            )
            if move:
                chosen = draw_below(
                    self.settings.seed or 0,
                    self.settings.name,
                    "walk",
                    self.bank_revision,
                    self.walk_count,
                    sum(selection.weights),
                )
                for offset, weight in zip(
                    selection.moves, selection.weights, strict=True
                ):
                    if chosen < weight:
                        rank = (rank + offset) % len(ordered)
                        break
                    chosen -= weight
            note = ordered[rank]
            self.walk_rank = rank
            self.walk_count += 1
        else:
            note = next(
                (
                    n
                    for n in ordered
                    if self.previous_note is None
                    or self._selection_key(n) > self._selection_key(self.previous_note)
                ),
                ordered[0],
            )
        self.previous_note = note
        if self.ports.selection_offset.ranks:
            ranked = sorted(
                active,
                key=lambda n: self._entry_key(n, Fraction(n.rank), False),
            )
            if (
                rank := self.ports.offset_rank(ranked.index(note), len(ranked))
            ) is None:
                return False
            note = ranked[rank]
        if (value := self._realize(note, decision.accent, pitch_interval)) is None:
            return False
        interval = decision.duration / decision.repeats
        self.pending.extend(
            _Attack[Payload](
                at=at + i * interval,
                note=note,
                value=value,
                accent=decision.accent,
                gate=decision.final_gate
                if i == decision.repeats - 1
                else decision.gate,
            )
            for i in range(decision.repeats)
        )
        return True

    def _weighted_note(
        self, candidates: list[tuple[Item[Payload], int]], lane: str
    ) -> Item[Payload]:
        seed = self.settings.seed
        assert seed is not None
        chosen = draw_below(
            seed,
            self.settings.name,
            lane,
            self.bank_revision,
            self.choice_count,
            sum(w for _, w in candidates),
        )
        self.choice_count += 1
        index = 0
        while chosen >= candidates[index][1]:
            chosen -= candidates[index][1]
            index += 1
        return candidates[index][0]

    def _shuffle_note(
        self, ordered: list[Item[Payload]], selection: Shuffle
    ) -> Item[Payload]:
        seed = self.settings.seed
        assert seed is not None
        identities = [n.id for n in ordered]
        edited = self.shuffle_revision != self.bank_revision
        if edited and self.shuffle_order and selection.on_edit == "preserve":
            played = self.shuffle_order[: self.shuffle_position]
            self.shuffle_order = [i for i in self.shuffle_order if i in identities]
            self.shuffle_position = sum(i in identities for i in played)
            for identity in identities:
                if identity not in self.shuffle_order:
                    offset = draw_below(
                        seed,
                        self.settings.name,
                        "shuffle",
                        self.bank_revision,
                        self.shuffle_count,
                        len(self.shuffle_order) - self.shuffle_position + 1,
                    )
                    self.shuffle_count += 1
                    self.shuffle_order.insert(self.shuffle_position + offset, identity)
        restart = not self.shuffle_order or (edited and selection.on_edit == "restart")
        finished = self.shuffle_position == len(self.shuffle_order)
        if restart or (finished and selection.mode == "cycle"):
            self.shuffle_order = identities
            self.shuffle_position = 0
            for index in range(len(self.shuffle_order) - 1, 0, -1):
                chosen = draw_below(
                    seed,
                    self.settings.name,
                    "shuffle",
                    self.bank_revision,
                    self.shuffle_count,
                    index + 1,
                )
                self.shuffle_count += 1
                self.shuffle_order[index], self.shuffle_order[chosen] = (
                    self.shuffle_order[chosen],
                    self.shuffle_order[index],
                )
            if (
                selection.no_repeat
                and len(self.shuffle_order) > 1
                and self.previous_note is not None
                and self.shuffle_order[0] == self.previous_note.id
            ):
                chosen = 1 + draw_below(
                    seed,
                    self.settings.name,
                    "shuffle",
                    self.bank_revision,
                    self.shuffle_count,
                    len(self.shuffle_order) - 1,
                )
                self.shuffle_count += 1
                self.shuffle_order[0], self.shuffle_order[chosen] = (
                    self.shuffle_order[chosen],
                    self.shuffle_order[0],
                )
        elif finished:
            self.shuffle_position = 0
        self.shuffle_revision = self.bank_revision
        identity = self.shuffle_order[self.shuffle_position]
        self.shuffle_position += 1
        return next(n for n in ordered if n.id == identity)

    def _attack(self, attack: _Attack[Payload]) -> list[Event]:
        at, note = attack.at, attack.note
        events: list[Event] = []
        remaining: list[_Active[Payload]] = []
        for sounding in self.sounding:
            if self._conflicts(sounding.value, attack.value):
                events.append(
                    self._event(
                        at=at,
                        kind="off",
                        id=sounding.id,
                        source_id=sounding.source_id,
                        value=sounding.value,
                        accent=sounding.accent,
                    )
                )
            else:
                remaining.append(sounding)
        self.sounding = remaining
        output_id = self.next_output_id
        self.next_output_id += 1
        events.append(
            self._event(
                at=at,
                kind="on",
                id=output_id,
                source_id=note.source_id,
                value=attack.value,
                accent=attack.accent,
            )
        )
        if (end := at + attack.gate) == at:
            events.append(
                self._event(
                    at=at,
                    kind="off",
                    id=output_id,
                    source_id=note.source_id,
                    value=attack.value,
                    accent=attack.accent,
                )
            )
        else:
            self.sounding.append(
                _Active[Payload](
                    id=output_id,
                    source_id=note.source_id,
                    value=attack.value,
                    accent=attack.accent,
                    end=end,
                )
            )
        return events

    def _release_all(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
        events = [
            self._event(
                at=at,
                kind="off",
                id=n.id,
                source_id=n.source_id,
                value=n.value,
                accent=n.accent,
            )
            for n in self.sounding
        ]
        self.sounding.clear()
        self.pending.clear()
        return events

    def _expand(self, active: list[Item[Payload]]) -> list[Item[Payload]]:
        return active

    def _realize(
        self, note: Item[Payload], accent: Fraction, pitch_interval: int
    ) -> Payload | None:
        if pitch_interval:
            raise ValueError("pitch intervals require a musical destination")
        return note.value

    def _conflicts(self, left: Payload, right: Payload) -> bool:
        return False

    @abstractmethod
    def _event(
        self,
        at: Fraction,
        kind: Literal["on", "off"],
        id: int,
        source_id: int,
        value: Payload,
        accent: Fraction,
    ) -> Event:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def _selection_key(self, note: Item[Payload]) -> tuple[int, Fraction, int, int]:
        selection = self.selection
        if isinstance(selection, Played):
            position = -note.onset if selection.direction == "reverse" else note.onset
        else:
            position = Fraction(
                -note.rank if isinstance(selection, Descending) else note.rank
            )
        reverse = (
            isinstance(selection, Descending)
            or isinstance(selection, Played)
            and selection.direction == "reverse"
        )
        return self._entry_key(note, position, reverse)

    def _entry_key(
        self, note: Item[Payload], position: Fraction, reverse: bool
    ) -> tuple[int, Fraction, int, int]:
        return 0, position, note.source_id, 0

def press(
    self, at: Fraction, identity: int, rank: int, value: Payload
) -> list[Event]:
    """Add an item, leaving the step at ``at`` for ``advance``."""
    self._check_time(at)
    note = Item[Payload](
        id=self.next_input_id,
        source_id=self.next_input_id,
        identity=identity,
        rank=rank,
        value=value,
        onset=at,
    )
    events = self._process_until(at, inclusive=False)
    new_chord = not self.input
    self.input.append(note)
    edited = isinstance(self.bank_mode, HeldBank)
    if isinstance(self.bank_mode, LatchedBank):
        if self.bank_mode.update == "replace":
            if new_chord:
                self.bank.clear()
            self.bank.append(note)
            edited = True
        elif self.bank_mode.update == "add":
            self.bank.append(note)
            edited = True
        elif self.bank_mode.update == "toggle":
            if self.toggle_at != at:
                self.toggle_at = at
                self.toggled_identities.clear()
                self.toggle_added_identities.clear()
            if identity not in self.toggled_identities:
                edited = True
                self.toggled_identities.append(identity)
                if any(n.identity == identity for n in self.bank):
                    self.bank = [n for n in self.bank if n.identity != identity]
                else:
                    self.bank.append(note)
                    self.toggle_added_identities.append(identity)
            elif identity in self.toggle_added_identities:
                self.bank.append(note)
                edited = True
        if not self.bank:
            self.previous_note = None
            self.pattern_position = 0
            self.shuffle_order.clear()
            self.shuffle_position = 0
            events.extend(self._release_all(at))
    if edited:
        self.bank_revision += 1
    if edited and self.settings.retrigger == "bank_edit":
        self.previous_note = None
        self.pattern_position = 0
        self.shuffle_order.clear()
        self.shuffle_position = 0
    self.next_input_id += 1
    return events

def relocate(self, at: Fraction) -> list[Event]:
    """Seek the rhythm and restart traversal without forgetting held notes."""
    events = self._release_all(at)
    assert self.ports is not None
    self.ports.pending.clear()
    rhythm = self.settings.rhythm
    if isinstance(rhythm, Pattern):
        cycle = sum(
            (Fraction(s.duration.removesuffix(" beat")) for s in rhythm.steps),
            Fraction(0),
        )
        cycles = at // cycle
        self.next_step = cycles * cycle
        self.step_index = cycles * len(rhythm.steps)
        while self.next_step < at:
            self.next_step += decide_step(
                rhythm, self.step_index, self.settings.gate, self.settings.patterns
            ).duration
            self.step_index += 1
    else:
        assert isinstance(rhythm, (Grid, Euclidean))
        step = Fraction(rhythm.step.removesuffix(" beat"))
        self.step_index, self.next_step = grid_position(
            step, rhythm.swing, at, rhythm.groove
        )
    self.now = at
    self.previous_note = None
    self.rising = True
    self.pattern_position = 0
    self.shuffle_order.clear()
    self.shuffle_position = 0
    return events
